title: top-up: ephemeral cargo root telemetry and host-disk reservations
definition: Review how the ephemeral cargo root is measured and reported on the Work volume line and the host-disk estimate's detail, and that a failed measurement reads unknown rather than zero. Review that the babysitter's host-disk reservation ledger parses strictly, ignores expired or malformed files, and that admission and the dip credit cannot credit more than a reservation's bytes.
